answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files two quartz receipts: work and violet filing receipts. A violet panel sends a whisper naming one serial each epoch; the agent answers with the paired quartz receipt whose serial matches. A mismatched or rented pair fails the whisper test and burns the bond. 1,000 fakes cost 130,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its full share.
